Method of Attack: Exploitation of a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2017-7269) in IIS 6.0 WebDAV service via a malicious PROPFIND request with an oversized IF header causing buffer overflow and remote code execution
Discoverer: Two Chinese researchers from the Information Security Lab & School of Computer Science & Engineering, South China University of Technology Guangzhou, China
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code published on GitHub
